description_en: Updates the information of a specified live room by calling UpdateLiveRoom
description_zh: 调用UpdateLiveRoom更新指定直播相关信息
name: UpdateLiveRoom

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The ID contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The live room title. Supports Chinese and English characters with a maximum length of 32 characters
parameters.help_zh: 直播标题，支持中英文，最大长度32位
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The live room announcement. Supports Chinese and English characters with a maximum length of 256 characters
parameters.help_zh: 直播公告，支持中英文，最大长度256位
parameters.name: notice

parameters.help_en: The cover image of the live room. Specify the value as an image URL with a maximum length of 256 characters
parameters.help_zh: 直播封面，支持图片地址链接格式，最大长度256位
parameters.name: cover_url

parameters.help_en: The extension field. Pass as needed to record additional room properties
parameters.help_zh: 拓展字段，按需传递，需要额外记录的房间属性
parameters.name: extension

parameters.help_en: The anchor ID. Supports only letters and digits with a maximum length of 36 characters
parameters.help_zh: 主播ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36位
parameters.name: anchor_id

parameters.help_en: The anchor nickname. Supports Chinese and English characters with a maximum length of 32 characters
parameters.help_zh: 主播昵称，支持中英文，最大长度32位
parameters.name: anchor_nick

parameters.help_en: The operator ID. Supports only letters and digits with a maximum length of 36 characters
parameters.help_zh: 操作人ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36位
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the live room
parameters.name: live_id
